name: Yohji Yamamoto
notes: Official online store THE SHOP YOHJI YAMAMOTO sells in yen and delivers in Japan only (Yamato, flat ¥550 nationwide, free over ¥10,000); its menu lists MEN and WOMEN > BOTTOMS > PANTS (https://theshopyohjiyamamoto.jp/shop/pages/delivery.aspx). No US prices, so no pants price is stored.

US store: Yohji Yamamoto NEW YORK WOOSTER, 52 Wooster Street, New York, NY 10013, carrying Yohji Yamamoto, Yohji Yamamoto POUR HOMME, Y's, Ground Y and S'YTE (https://www.yohjiyamamoto.co.jp/shopinfo/).
Official store meta description: S'YTE is an online-only brand, Ground Y is a genderless unisex brand, and Y's is the first brand Yohji Yamamoto designed (https://theshopyohjiyamamoto.jp/).
